verdict.rationale: Column's first-party docs show sending and receiving domestic wires over Fedwire, plus sending, receiving and requesting payment over both FedNow and RTP. Each rail has its own documentation page. All rails sit behind one API defined by an OpenAPI spec, with a unified endpoint for querying transfers across payment types. Missing for 10: per-rail limits, cutoffs and capability differences (e.g., FedNow vs RTP specifics) are not shown in the excerpts; no sandbox simulation shown for real-time rails; no independent or hands-on corroboration of the wire or real-time rails.
